gloss: long and thin; elongated and narrow

definitions.gloss: long and thin; elongated and narrow; slender
definitions.explanation: Describing an object or shape that is notably long relative to its width. A compound adjective combining the concepts of length and thinness.

examples.japanese: {長細|ながぼそ}い{形|かたち}のパンを{買|か}った。
examples.english: I bought a long, narrow loaf of bread.

examples.japanese: この{島|しま}は{南北|なんぼく}に{長細|ながぼそ}く、{車|くるま}で{端|はし}から{端|はし}まで{三時間|さんじかん}かかる。
examples.english: This island is long and narrow from north to south, and it takes three hours to drive from one end to the other.

notes:
A compound adjective from {長|なが}い (long) + {細|ほそ}い (thin), with rendaku changing ほそい to ぼそい. Also written as {長|なが}{細|ぼそ}い. A straightforward descriptive word used in everyday conversation.

USAGE:
Used for physical objects and shapes. The variant {細長|ほそなが}い is more common in formal writing and has the same meaning, but reverses the order of the components.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {長細|ながぼそ}い{形|かたち} — a long, thin shape
- {長細|ながぼそ}い{箱|はこ} — a long, narrow box
- {長細|ながぼそ}い{島|しま} — a long, narrow island
- {長細|ながぼそ}い{顔|かお} — a long, narrow face

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {細長|ほそなが}い — long and thin (same meaning; more common in formal writing)
- {細|ほそ}い — thin, slender (thinness only, without the length component)
- {長|なが}い — long (length only, without the thinness component)

forms.label: Conditional たら
forms.negative: {長細|ながぼそ}くなかったら
